initialExam.title: BSF Constable (GD) 2026
initialExam.description: BSF Constable General Duty recruitment for India's premier border guarding force. Recruited through SSC GD.
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence (20Q), General Knowledge (20Q), Elementary Math (20Q), English/Hindi (20Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 80 questions, 160 marks, 60 min. Physical: 5km run, Long Jump, High Jump.
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through SSC GD notification at ssc.gov.in 2. Select BSF preference
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Ration, Uniform Allowance, Border Allowance, Medical, Pension
